title: Build the ingest pipeline from SPEC.md (dirty CSVs in, report out)
prompt: Implement the ingest pipeline described in SPEC.md: write pipeline/run.mjs (Node standard library only), run `node pipeline/run.mjs` from the repo root so that out/report.json and out/summary.md are produced, and check them against SPEC.md yourself. The CSVs in events/ deliberately contain every quirk the SPEC mentions.
